en: New: Team sharing is live! Click the share button on Build or Saved Teams Page to copy a link or export a team card.
zh: 新功能：队伍分享上线！在构筑页面或队伍操作里点击分享，即可复制分享链接或导出队伍卡片！

en: New: Game terms with underline in move and trait descriptions now have tooltips! Hover on them with mouse or tap on them with mobile to see the explanation.
zh: 新功能：技能、特性描述里带下划线的游戏术语，电脑悬停或手机点击一下就能快速查看说明啦！

en: Update: Move data has been updated to reflect the latest game content!
zh: 【更新】技能数据也已同步最新内容～

en: Update: Some jingling's move pools and base stats have been updated, please load your saved teams on Build Page to check if the moves are still valid!
zh: 【更新】修复了部分精灵技能池以及种族值数据，建议在构筑页面重新打开已保存的队伍确认技能是否有效！

en: New: Evolution levels and special evolution conditions for all jinglings have been added to the Dex!
zh: 新功能：图鉴已添加全部精灵的进化等级以及特殊进化条件！

en: New: Click「Jingling Analysis」on any jingling slot in the builder to view type matchups, move coverage, and final PvP stats with a survivability calculator.
zh: 新功能：在构筑器精灵面板中点击「精灵分析」，即可查看属性克制关系、技能打击面与含性格和个体值的PvP最终属性，附带生存能力计算器！

en: New: A built-in two-way type matchup calculator has been added to the Dex! On mobile, swipe the top tab bar right to find it. Also, type effectiveness is now shown in move details!
zh: 新功能：图鉴里新增双向属性克制查询！手机端需要在上方导航栏向右滑动才能看到哦。此外，技能详情里现在也能查看属性克制啦！

en: New: A PvP stats calculator has been added to the Build Page! Input a jingling's level, IVs, and nature to see the final stats used in PvP battles.
zh: 新功能：构筑页面新增PvP属性计算器！输入精灵的等级、个体值和性格，即可查看PvP战斗中使用的最终属性！
